items.title: Dawoud Sabu Adeyola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 30, 2025
items.q: Benny Carter was a big part of that. Benny Carter, because of his stature, I mean he’s the king you know, and he got involved with the union.

ctx.x: I see his name on your promo material.

Elvin Shepherd was a great musician. He was Grover Washington’s teacher. And when Grover went, if you ever see any interviews about Grover Washington and they ask him about, like you asked me about my background, he always goes on and on and on about how great Elvin Shepherd was. And Elvin Shepherd was a member of the Local 533, the black musicians union, which is a whole ‘nother story. I was so blessed to be a part of that. I joined that union six months before it was dissolved. You know? I mean the union, the…
Did you notice a positive or negative circumstances that followed that merging of the union?
